instruction: Underline the title text on slide 3 of the presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated to slides 2, 3, 5 and attempted to change title colors to black and add underline. Successfully changed font color on slide 2 via Character dialog but failed to consistently apply underline across all target slides.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate between slides, select title text, open Character formatting dialog, apply underline via Ctrl+U
metadata.failure_analysis: Model opened Character dialog on slide 3 and set color to black, but the Underlining field showed (Without), indicating underline was not applied on this slide.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to single-slide, single-property task (underline only on slide 3) to test if model can apply underline formatting to a single title
metadata.explanation: Task requires underlining the title text on slide 3. Getter finds the title shape (largest font) on slide 3 and checks underline status of all runs. Metric verifies all runs are underlined with partial credit.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly targets slide 3 using slide_index=2 (0-indexed), matching the instruction.
Getter extracts underline status from all text runs in the title shape, providing comprehensive coverage.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' — directly accesses expected.get('expected_underlined') without incorrectly wrapping in rules/type.
Postconfig saves the file (Ctrl+S) before evaluation, ensuring the getter reads the latest state.
Partial credit logic is sensible: rewards proportional underline application across runs.
Minor: Title identification uses largest-font-size heuristic instead of placeholder type detection, which could misidentify the title in atypical slide layouts.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider identifying the title shape via shape.is_placeholder and placeholder_format.type instead of largest font size, for more robust title detection in edge cases.
